gap.prompt: My sister ___ breakfast at seven every morning.
gap.explain: With she, use has in the present simple.

gap.prompt: There ___ two big windows in my room.
We ___ to the beach last summer.
gap.explain: Last summer needs the past simple.

gap.prompt: I ___ my homework before dinner yesterday.
gap.explain: Use did for a finished past action.

gap.prompt: The bus is ___ than the train.
Can you ___ me with this exercise, please?
gap.explain: After can, use the base verb.

gap.prompt: She is ___ a message to her friend now.
I don’t ___ coffee in the evening.
gap.explain: After don’t, use the base verb.

mistake.sentence: I am agree with your idea.
She can to swim very well.
mistake.explain: After can, use swim without to.

mistake.sentence: My parents is at home today.
I bought a new phone yesterday.
mistake.explain: Use a before a consonant sound.

mistake.sentence: There is many people in the shop.

phrase.prompt: I want to ___ a new job next year.
Please ___ off your shoes before you enter.
phrase.explain: Take off means remove clothes or shoes.

phrase.prompt: Can you ___ the music down? It is too loud.
I need to ___ an appointment with the doctor.
She ___ the bus to work every day.

formation.explain: Add -er for the person who drives.
Use the adjective to describe a thing.
Use the noun form of inform.

formation.prompt: I want to ___ my English this year. (BETTER)
formation.explain: Use the verb meaning make better.

alternatives: My brother plays football on Sunday.
